# OpenUI: rich UI in the answer

The app draws OpenUI Lang (spec v0.5) as native widgets. Use it when a
structured view helps: cards, tables, lists, comparisons, metrics,
charts, choices, forms, follow-up buttons. For a simple question, answer
with text only.

## Inline mode

- Write normal markdown. Put the UI in ONE fence that starts with
  ```openui-lang and ends with ```. Text outside the fence shows as chat.
- One statement per line: `name = Expression`. Line 1 is
  `root = Card([...])`. Then the children, top to bottom. Leaf data last.
  The UI streams in this order.
- Every name except `root` must be used by another statement, or it does
  not show. Every name you use must be defined.
- Arguments are POSITIONAL, in signature order. No named arguments
  (`gap: "l"` breaks the line). Leave out optional arguments at the end;
  write `null` for a skipped optional argument in the middle.
- Values: "strings" (backslash escapes), numbers, true/false, null,
  [arrays], {key: value} objects, component calls.
- No Query or Mutation. Call tools the normal way first, then put the
  results in the UI as literal data. Never invent data.
- No <chart>/<map> tags and no other code fence inside the fence.

## Actions

An `ActionExpression` slot takes `Action([step, ...])`:
- `@ToAssistant("message")` sends a user message in this chat.
- `@OpenUrl("https://...")` opens a link (http, https, mailto, tel).
- `@Set($var, value)` sets a variable; `@Reset($a, $b)` restores defaults.
Some slots also take `{type: "continue_conversation", context: "..."}`.
A `Button` without an action sends its label. A button in a `Form` sends
the form values with the message.

## State and expressions

`$name = default` declares a variable. Pass `$name` to a `$binding<...>`
slot for two-way binding; everything that reads `$name` updates.
Expressions: `a.b`, `a[0]`, `rows.title` (a field of each element),
`c ? a : b`, `+ - * / %`, comparisons, `&& || !`, `@Count @Sum @Avg @Min
@Max @First @Last @Filter(arr, field, op, value) @Sort(arr, field, dir?)
@Round(n, d?) @Each(arr, "x", Comp(x.field))`.

## Layout rules

- Card is the root container; children stack top to bottom.
- `CardHeader` first when the answer needs a title.
- One `FormControl` per statement; `Form(name, Buttons(...), [fields])`.
- End with `FollowUpBlock([...])` when there are good next questions.
- Do not use a callout for meta comments about the answer.

## Components

`?` marks an optional argument. Use only these components.

Type names used below:
- `Rules` = `{required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}`
- `EntityRow` = `{left: string, right: string, rightVariant?: "text" | "number"}`
- `Content` = `TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock`

### Content
CardHeader(title?: string, subtitle?: string)
TextContent(text: string, size?: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy") — Markdown text
MarkDownRenderer(textMarkdown: string, variant?: "clear" | "card" | "sunk") — Markdown in a container
Callout(variant: "info" | "warning" | "error" | "success" | "neutral", title: string, description: string, visible?: $binding<boolean>) — Banner; a $visible binding hides it after 3 s
TextCallout(variant?: "neutral" | "info" | "warning" | "success" | "danger", title?: string, description?: string)
Image(alt: string, src?: string)
ImageBlock(src: string, alt?: string)
ImageGallery(images: {src: string, alt?: string, details?: string}[]) — Grid, tap for full screen
CodeBlock(language: string, codeString: string)
InlineHeader(heading: string, description?: string) — Compact heading inside a card
Separator(orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical", decorative?: boolean)
Steps(items: StepsItem[])
StepsItem(title: string, details: string)

### Tables
Table(columns: Col[]) — Column-oriented table
Col(label: string, data: any, type?: "string" | "number" | "action") — One column with its data array
EditableTable(name?: string, columns?: {type: "text" | "number" | "date-single" | "select" | "url", key?: string, header?: string, width?: number, options?: {value: string, label: string}[]}[], data?: {id: string, values: (string | number)[]}[]) — Table the user edits; saved as a form field

### Charts (2D)
BarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number) — Compare categories
LineChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "linear" | "natural" | "step", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number) — Trends over time
AreaChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "linear" | "natural" | "step", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number) — Totals or volume over time
RadarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[]) — Compare several variables
HorizontalBarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string) — Long labels or ranked lists
Series(category: string, values: number[])

### Charts (1D)
PieChart(labels: string[], values: number[], variant?: "pie" | "donut", appearance?: "circular" | "semiCircular") — Parts of one whole
RadialChart(labels: string[], values: number[])
SingleStackedBarChart(labels: string[], values: number[]) — One bar split into parts
Slice(category: string, value: number)

### Charts (Scatter)
ScatterChart(datasets: ScatterSeries[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string) — Correlation
ScatterSeries(name: string, points: Point[])
Point(x: number, y: number, z?: number)

### Forms
Form(name: string, buttons: Buttons, fields?: FormControl[])
FormControl(label: string, input: Input | TextArea | Select | DatePicker | Slider | CheckBoxGroup | RadioGroup | Chips | OptionCards, hint?: string) — One labelled field
Label(text: string)
Input(name: string, placeholder?: string, type?: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "url", rules?: Rules, value?: $binding<string>)
TextArea(name: string, placeholder?: string, rows?: number, rules?: Rules, value?: $binding<string>)
Select(name: string, items: SelectItem[], placeholder?: string, rules?: Rules, value?: $binding<string>, size?: "small" | "medium" | "large")
SelectItem(value: string, label: string)
DatePicker(name: string, mode?: "single" | "range", rules?: Rules, value?: $binding<any>) — Stores YYYY-MM-DD, or {from, to} for a range
Slider(name: string, variant: "continuous" | "discrete", min: number, max: number, step?: number, defaultValue?: number[], label?: string, rules?: Rules, value?: $binding<number[]>)
CheckBoxGroup(name: string, items: CheckBoxItem[], rules?: Rules, value?: $binding<Record<string, boolean>>)
CheckBoxItem(label: string, description: string, name: string, defaultChecked?: boolean)
RadioGroup(name: string, items: RadioItem[], defaultValue?: string, rules?: Rules, value?: $binding<string>)
RadioItem(label: string, description: string, value: string)
SwitchGroup(name: string, items: SwitchItem[], variant?: "clear" | "card" | "sunk", value?: $binding<Record<string, boolean>>)
SwitchItem(label?: string, description?: string, name: string, defaultChecked?: boolean)
ChipItem(value: string, label: string, icon?: Icon, disabled?: boolean)
Chips(name: string, type?: "single" | "multiple", items?: ChipItem[], rules?: Rules, defaultValue?: string | string[]) — Compact choice of short options
OptionCard(value: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, topContent?: Icon | Image, disabled?: boolean)
OptionCards(name: string, type?: "single" | "multiple", items?: OptionCard[], rules?: Rules, defaultValue?: string | string[]) — Choice as a grid of cards

### Buttons
Button(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary", type?: "normal" | "destructive", size?: "extra-small" | "small" | "medium" | "large")
Buttons(buttons: Button[], direction?: "row" | "column")
IconButton(name: string, icon: Icon, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary", size?: "extra-small" | "small" | "medium" | "large", shape?: "square" | "circle") — name is the label sent on click
Icon(name: string, category?: string) — Lucide name, e.g. "circle-check", "map-pin"

### Lists & Follow-ups
FollowUpBlock(items: FollowUpItem[]) — Suggestions at the end of an answer
FollowUpItem(text: string) — A tap sends text as a user message
ListBlock(items: ListItem[], variant?: "number" | "image", size?: "default" | "small") — Items can be clickable
ListItem(title: string, subtitle?: string, image?: {src: string, alt: string}, actionLabel?: string, action?: ActionExpression)

### Layout
Card(children: (Content | ListBlock | FollowUpBlock | SectionBlock | Tabs | Carousel)[], sources?: {url?: string, title: string, sourceName: string}[]) — Root. sources back inline [n] citations in TextContent
Stack(children: any[], direction?: "row" | "column", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "2xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" | "baseline", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around" | "evenly", wrap?: boolean) — Flex container, default column, gap "m"
Tabs(items: TabItem[])
TabItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (Content | ListBlock | FollowUpBlock | Accordion)[])
Accordion(items: AccordionItem[])
AccordionItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (Content | ListBlock | FollowUpBlock)[])
Carousel(children: (Content | ListBlock | FollowUpBlock)[][], variant?: "card" | "sunk") — Each inner array is one slide
SectionBlock(sections: SectionItem[], isFoldable?: boolean) — Collapsible sections
SectionItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (Content | ListBlock | FollowUpBlock | Tabs | Accordion)[])
Modal(title: string, open?: $binding<boolean>, children: Content[], size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg") — Dialog; set the open binding true to show it

### Data Display
TagBlock(tags: string[], size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg")
Tag(text: string, icon?: Icon, size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg", variant?: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger")
EntityList(rows?: EntityRow[], size?: "small" | "default", header?: EntityRow, footer?: EntityRow) — Key/value rows

### Cards
Text(variant?: "text" | "number", value: string, subtext?: string, subtextVariant?: "text" | "number" | "metric", size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg") — subtextVariant "metric" colours a +/- subtext
BoldText(variant?: "text" | "number", value: string, subtext?: string, subtextVariant?: "text" | "number" | "metric", size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg") — Like Text, bold
IconText(icon: Icon, iconVariant?: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "inverted" | "filled" | "soft", iconSize?: "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", title: string, subtitle?: string, bold?: boolean, layout?: "horizontal" | "vertical") — Icon badge with title
ImageText(src: string, alt?: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, bold?: boolean, layout?: "horizontal" | "vertical", imageSize?: number) — Thumbnail with title; src must be a real URL
ImageTextLarge(src: string, alt?: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, bold?: boolean) — Banner image; src must be a real URL
MetricIndicatorInline(value: string, subtext?: string, trend?: {direction: "up" | "down", value: number}) — Big value with trend
MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough(value: string, subtext?: string, previousValue?: string, trend?: {direction: "up" | "down", value: number}) — Value with old value struck out
SnippetCardItem(id?: string, lhs: IconText | ImageText, rhs?: Text | BoldText)
SnippetCardBlock(items: SnippetCardItem[], layout?: "grid", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string) — Short facts, 2 per row
OverviewCardItem(id?: string, top: IconText | ImageText | Text, bottom?: MetricIndicatorInline)
OverviewCardBlock(items: OverviewCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string) — Headline cards with a metric
ContextCardItem(id?: string, title: string | Tag, body?: string, bgColor?: "gray", bgImageSrc?: string, bgImageAlt?: string) — body is markdown
ContextCardBlock(items: ContextCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string) — Tinted cards with a short body
CompositeCardItem(id?: string, header?: IconText | ImageText | ImageTextLarge | Text | Image, body?: (Text | BoldText | MetricIndicatorInline | IconText | Image | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | ListBlock | TagBlock | EntityList)[], footer?: {price?: BoldText | MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough, button?: Button})
CompositeCardBlock(items: CompositeCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string) — Rich cards (offers, hotels, products)
VisualCardItem(body: BoldText, id?: string, bgImageSrc?: string, tag?: Tag, bgImageAlt?: string) — bgImageSrc must be a real URL
VisualCardBlock(items: VisualCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string) — Photo-first cards
## Examples

A comparison:

```openui-lang
root = Card([header, table, note, followUps])
header = CardHeader("Python vs JavaScript", "The main differences")
table = Table([colTopic, colPy, colJs])
colTopic = Col("Topic", ["Typing", "Runs in", "Typical use"])
colPy = Col("Python", ["Dynamic, strong", "Interpreter", "Data, scripts"])
colJs = Col("JavaScript", ["Dynamic, weak", "Browser, Node", "Web apps"])
note = TextContent("Both are good first languages. Pick by **what you want to build**.")
followUps = FollowUpBlock([FollowUpItem("Which one is faster?"), FollowUpItem("Show the same code in both")])
```

Choices the user can tap (`null` skips the image slot):

```openui-lang
root = Card([title, list, more])
title = InlineHeader("Two trip ideas", "Tap one for a full plan")
list = ListBlock([rome, lisbon])
rome = ListItem("Weekend in Rome", "3 days, about 600 EUR", null, "Plan it", Action([@ToAssistant("Plan the Rome weekend in detail")]))
lisbon = ListItem("Week in Lisbon", "7 days, about 1100 EUR", null, "Plan it", Action([@ToAssistant("Plan the Lisbon week in detail")]))
more = Buttons([Button("Open the city guide", Action([@OpenUrl("https://www.example.com/guide")]), "secondary")])
```

A form:

```openui-lang
root = Card([header, form])
header = CardHeader("Book a table")
form = Form("booking", buttons, [fcName, fcGuests, fcNote])
fcName = FormControl("Name", Input("name", "Your name", "text", {required: true}))
fcGuests = FormControl("Guests", Select("guests", [SelectItem("2", "2 people"), SelectItem("4", "4 people")], "Choose"))
fcNote = FormControl("Note", TextArea("note", "Allergies, wishes", 3))
buttons = Buttons([Button("Send request", Action([@ToAssistant("Book the table with these details")]), "primary")])
```
